no_server: No Vinyl-Mind server is set. Enter the address of a server first.
url_invalid: The server address must start with https:// (http:// only for this computer itself).
url_parts: The server address must name a host and must not contain a user name, password, query or fragment.
recording: A recording is running. Vinyl-Mind waits until it has finished.
not_joined: This station has not joined the Vinyl-Mind server set here.
switches_off: Turn on Contribute or Use the global model first.
leave_first: This station is joined to {url}. Leave that server first.
key_changed: The server presented the key {got}, not the one you confirmed ({want}). Nothing was sent.
unreachable: The server {url} could not be reached: {error}
server_bad: The server's answer does not match the protocol ({error}).
redirect: The server tried to redirect to another address. Vinyl-Mind does not follow redirects.
too_large: The server's answer is larger than {kb} KiB.
request_too_large: The request would be larger than {kb} KiB.
err_pending: The server has not approved this station yet.
err_unknown_station: The server no longer knows this station (it left or was removed). Join again.
err_invitation_required: This server only admits stations with an invitation code.
err_invitation_invalid: The invitation code is not valid (unknown, expired or already used).
err_rate_limited: Too many requests. The server asks to wait a little.
err_unsupported_version: The server does not accept this version of vinyl-check's data. An update may be needed.
err_no_model: The server has not published a global model yet.
err_clock_skew: The clock of this computer is about {s} seconds off from the server's. Correct the time and try again.
model_unsigned: The model is not signed. It was discarded.
model_wrong_key: The model is signed with another key ({fp}) than the accepted server key. It was discarded.
model_bad_signature: The model's signature is not valid. It was discarded.
model_invalid: The model does not match the protocol ({error}). It was discarded.
version_mismatch: Feature version {got} does not match this station's feature version {want}.
detector_mismatch: Detector version {got} does not match this station's detector version {want}.
features_mismatch: The list of features does not match feature version {version}.
nothing_yet: Nothing to contribute yet: no kind of event has a trained model (at least {min} real ones and {min} false alarms per kind).
profile_not_measured: Nothing to contribute: feature version {version} needs a measured turntable profile (chain noise, and an accepted alignment run with reference level and click floor).
package_type: The file is neither a Vinyl-Mind contribution nor a global model.

package_invalid.one: The file is not a valid Vinyl-Mind package: {error}
package_invalid.other: The file is not a valid Vinyl-Mind package: {error} ({n} problems)

package_own: This contribution comes from one of this station's own turntable profiles.
package_too_large: The file is larger than {kb} KiB.
